From the Oka Sho to the Japanese Derby... 
Vodka kept agonizing over whether or not 
she should take on this unprecedented 
challenge.

Vodka went to consult Narita Brian, a 
veteran of the "Japan Derby"... but the 
only advice she received was to run purely 
on instinct.

Those words made Vodka rethink things... 
She realized that staying true to herself 
meant clamping down and fighting hard, no 
matter how reckless it seemed.

And so... to stay true to herself, she 
chose to run in the Japanese Derby rather 
than face her rival in the Yushun Himba 
(Oaks).
